items.summary: What happens when AI hacking tools designed to protect us become weapons for cybercriminals? This week on Hak5’s ThreatWire, Ali Diamond investigates how AI penetration testing tools ARTEX and CAIRN are fueling global cyberattacks, why the FBI is sounding the alarm, and whether Anthropic’s Project Glasswing is delivering on its cybersecurity promises. items.title: ARTEX - Agentic AI-Driven Cyberattacks Are Happening at Scale
items.summary: AI-powered pen testing frameworks like ARTEX are now fueling real-world cyberattacks at unprecedented speed and scale, making the internet actively hostile for organizations of every size. Steve and Leo both examine the chilling reality of automated, always-on adversaries and the constant scramble to keep up. • An overview of the past several weeks of widespread outages • The “Reverse Engineer Anything” craze hits a road bump. • Quad9 withdraws its DNS service from France. What’s next? • California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face and more. • More critical vulnerabilities in Synology. • PHP vulnerabilities, round two. • Google and Anthropic reduce their disclosure windows. • A listener uses Mythos, discovers unexpected bugs. • SpinRite boots on 97 different UEFI PCs. • ARTEX - The inevitable happened, and it's bad.
